   (B2 §7 definitions); `prefix` for `*.jsonl` with schema validity,
   `recorded_at ≤ commit UTC`, chaining to the obligation's last event;

4. **Replay oracle:** `memory_guard.py replay` over history flags exactly the

6. **Fixtures:** one passing and one failing diff per mode (B2 §7's commits)

7. **C-10 / ADR-146:** `db/sqitch.plan` stays `append-only` for the whole

## Part b — the oracle, the replay and the nightly

- **Replay oracle** (`tests/unit/fixtures/memory_guard/replay_expected.csv`,
  generated by `memory_guard.py oracle-gen` — never hand-copied, OM-15):
  466 derived rows = 32 append-register positives (`loss` +
  `transition-unjustified`, wildcard `(check,rule)` because the register names
  the cell not the check family), 311 benign clean cells (cells holding a
  register positive are never also `clean`), 103 guard-visible misdated-stamp
  cells (`date_row_visible` re-judges each class-b row against the introducing
  commit's own diff — position collection + R1/R2 + `allow`/`future-ok:`/
  correction-context suppression under the policy in force at that commit —
  so a wrong-but-invisible event date is not a manufactured miss), and 20
  B4-G2-amendment-1 position-scan commits (insertion inside the base
  `## GATE DECISIONS` region re-derived from `git diff -U0`).
- **Reviewed disagreement set** — B4: "a disagreement is reviewed by hand
  before the oracle changes, never silently re-baselined". The completed modes
  are strictly stronger than the B1-era classification, so the first clean
  replay still carried disagreements. Each was adjudicated cell-by-cell and is
  recorded in the oracle itself with `source=reviewed`:
  - 157 `waived` rows: 155 register-benign cells the completed modes
    legitimately flag (run-ledger in-place edits, DEFERRALS row rewrites,
    index row rewrites, landed-ADR/ticket edits, mid-region insertions — the
    benign class predates these modes) plus 2 register-attribution misses
    (`d76c22eb`, `e8bc0179` DEFERRALS — the stamps were already in the parent
    row; the grown re-carriage adds no new stamp to flag).
  - 346 `violation` rows ratifying the completed-mode findings on those cells
    (plus `record-shape`/`record-dates`/`readouts` findings the registers never
    evaluated — index schema drift, `PR pending` rows, sqitch `planned_at`
    stamps before `allow` entries existed, pre-convention readouts, the
    obligation-ledger re-anchor migration).
- **Replay result** (`docs/build/reports/memory-repair/P34.7-replay.json`,
  `replay a33177c7..HEAD`): 651 first-parent commits judged, 259 with
  violations, 7 vacuous early commits; oracle comparison **0 missed, 0
  breached, 0 unexpected, 160 reviewed-waived** — the replay result equals the
  reviewed expected set. All seed commits pass (`seed-commit` SHA-prefixed
  policy directive; the exemption is read from the checkout's policy so the
  historical-policy rule "a change may amend it" is untouched).
- **Nightly read-only replay** wired in `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`
  (`fetch-depth: 0` already present; the `replay` stage runs
  `memory_guard.py replay <root>..HEAD --oracle …` and feeds
  `scripts/ci/nightly_report.py` as a gate stage; per-stage logs + the JSON
  report are uploaded with the artifact). Read-only: judges diffs, writes only
  the run's artifacts.
